headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2019, a new chapter began as Riho vs. Nyla Rose fought for the brand-new AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.77. A true David-versus-Goliath contest to crown AEW's first-ever Women's World Champion ? Rose's power advantage looked overwhelming for long stretches, but Riho kept kicking out and won the crowd over completely before pulling off the underdog victory.

Back on this day in 2024, Will Ospreay vs. Ricochet put the AEW International Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.46 ? a match that delivered. It was the first title opportunity of Ricochet's career. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

On this day in 2024, the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Bryan Danielson vs. Kazuchika Okada went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.83 ? a match that delivered. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2019: Ortiz & Santana & Jericho vs. The Elite locked horns for the first time, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 6.24.
That Wednesday in 2019, PAC vs. Adam Page met for the very first time on Dynamite, rated 6.81.
Flash back to 2024, when it was the first-ever encounter between Adam Page and Juice Robinson on Dynamite, rated 6.60.
